claims.claim_text: The indexed Technician Fifth Grade Matthew F. Azzarone is confirmed in the official Army enlistment table.

claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact name and an exact unique private identifier across two official NARA records.
claims.temporal_assessment: The enlistment record documents Army entry as a private in March 1943; the later Technician Fifth Grade in the OSS index is compatible with advancement.
claims.match_notes: The private identifier is not quoted or exposed. Box 27 remains unreviewed, so the record does not establish an OSS entry date or immediate pre-OSS affiliation.
